problem_context.problem_statement: Remove one concrete node from a circular doubly linked list, reconnect neighbors, and return the exact sequence with that node removed.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Remove one concrete node from a circular doubly linked list, reconnect neighbors, and return the exact sequence with that node removed.
problem_context.input_output_contract: The public common DLL spec must type-check and be reusable at every call site; verification must preserve exact heap shape and abstract sequence behavior.
spec_hint: Reuse the approved common DLL predicates; specify exact prefix/removed/suffix sequence semantics and the detached node ownership without weakening invariants.
reference_case_hints: Use the approved QCIPLib/xizi/xizi_double_link_common definitions and single-link style only; never inspect QCP_demos_human.

hidden_properties: the prefix fragment omits precisely node_prev.node_next
the suffix fragment omits precisely node_next.node_prev
all other list and sentinel fields remain owned
empty prefix identifies node_prev with head

known_risks: the two generated manual entailments still require vc-checking and group-worker proofs; annotation-phase compilation only establishes statement and import well-formedness
annotation_design_summary.mathematical_behavior: The input abstract sequence is exactly prefix ++ linklist_node :: suffix; the result sequence is exactly prefix ++ suffix; the removed concrete node is retained as a non-null self-linked singleton DLL.
